question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Despicable
solution: The correct answer is **"Admirable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Despicable"** means deserving hatred and contempt. (निंदनीय, जघन्‍य) • **Example**: *He's a **despicable**__ human being!* • The antonym of **despicable** is **admirable**. • **"Admirable"** means deserving respect and approval. (प्रशंसनीय; श्रेष्‍ठ) __ • **Example**: *His charitable work is **admirable**__.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Rational)** means based on reason or logic. ((व्‍यक्ति) विवेकशील; समझदार (निर्णय करने में भावनाओं के स्‍थान पर तर्कबुद्धि का प्रयोग करने वाला)) • **Option 2 (Deplorable) **means deserving strong condemnation or shock. (शोचनीय, निंदनीय) • **Option 4 (Offensive) **means causing someone to feel deeply hurt, upset, or angry. (अप्रिय; अपमानजनक) 3b:Tb75, The correct answer is** "Overwelming."**
